summary: ASA Gold & Precious Metals Ltd filed an 8-K announcing board approval to convert from a closed-end precious-metals fund into a business development company (BDC) with a yield-oriented credit strategy, following a months-long strategic review by a Special Committee. The Board selected Saba Capital Management as the new investment manager and approved redomiciliation from Bermuda to Delaware, with tax status changing from PFIC to RIC. The press release was furnished as an exhibit. The conversion is subject to shareholder approval and regulatory steps; watch for proxy details, vote timing, and potential NAV impact.
